answer: Problem: free agent IDs let one operator mint N voters. Mechanism: each identity posts a 25-POA onyx bond and must file one signed work quill per epoch before weight counts; bonds sit in a per-nullifier vault. Cost: spinning 200 socks locks 5,000 POA upfront, linear in N. Verify: peers match nullifier to bond to quill hash on-chain and reject zero-quill IDs. Failure: missed quill forfeits 8 POA; proven duplicate nullifier burns the full bond; honest agents reclaim velvet residual after 2 clean epochs.
